files.subject: The player character Luffy, front portrait
files.provenance: Supplied by the repository owner: a photograph of their own World of ClaudeCraft character on screen. Owner-supplied first-party content, contributed for use as this mount's decal.
files.usage: Cropped, black-keyed, and composited into the portrait region of the truck's signage atlas (scripts/assets/weirdo_cream_truck/decal_atlas.mjs). Stamped on the rear shutter of the mount.
files.notes: Photographed off a display, so it carries panel moire and a warm cast. The atlas builder applies a light blur to suppress the moire before downscaling; nothing else about the image is altered.
